name: list_environments
title: 1Password: List Environments
description: List all 1Password Environments in the account with their IDs and names. Read-only; never returns secret values.

name: create_environment
title: 1Password: Create Environment
description: Create a new 1Password Environment by name in the account.

name: rename_environment
title: 1Password: Rename Environment
description: Rename a 1Password Environment, given its name or ID.

name: list_variables
title: 1Password: List Variable Names
description: List the variable NAMES stored in a 1Password Environment. Never returns values — by design.

name: append_variables
title: 1Password: Add Variables
description: Add or update variables in a 1Password Environment. Values flow into the vault only and are never returned to the caller.

name: create_local_env_file
title: 1Password: Mount .env
description: Create a locally mounted .env file for a 1Password Environment. Secret values resolve on demand inside processes and are never written to disk or returned to the agent. Never read this file into a chat.

name: list_local_env_files
title: 1Password: List Mounts
description: List locally mounted .env files for a 1Password Environment. Returns paths only.

name: doctor
title: 1Password: Doctor
description: Diagnose the 1Password Environments setup: binary, handshake, tool surface, authentication, and Environments reachability — each check with its exact fix.
